name: What should I do immediately if water is leaking from my ceiling?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if water is leaking from my ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you discover a water leak, immediately try to contain the water by placing buckets or towels to minimize damage. If safe to do so, identify the source and turn off the water supply to that area or the main water supply to your home. Avoid standing water near electrical outlets. Contact a professional restoration company like First To Respond Restoration promptly. They can assess the damage, stop the source, and begin the water extraction and drying process to prevent further harm.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contain the water with buckets, turn off the water supply if possible, and contact a professional restoration company immediately to assess and mitigate the damage.
